verdict.rationale: Shortcut connects coding agents such as Cursor and Claude Code to GitHub and tracks agent work, so reviewing agent code changes is a plausible axis for it. However, the evidence shows no mobile app, no line-level code review or commenting, and no loop where review comments trigger an agent to iterate. Its GitHub integration and MCP server are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
